china-1923:p0700_2.rationale: Chinese Eastern Railway 1914 accounts: operating profit, special-enterprise deficit and total deficit. These are company operating accounts of a railway.

china-1923:p0702_1.rationale: Railway cash reserve held in various currencies and forms (silver, gold, paper roubles). It is a financial account of holdings; currency is the closest tag, though it is a company cash position.
review_questions: Is there a need for a company balance-sheet or assets tag for railway cash reserves?

china-1923:p0702_2.rationale: Value of the railway's stocks of fuel and materials in gold roubles; a company asset account with no fitting detailed tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for company assets or inventories/stocks of materials.

china-1923:p0703_1.rationale: Creditors and debtors account of the Chinese Eastern Railway, giving sums due to and owed by it and the balance against it.

china-1923:p0703_2.rationale: Itemised creditors of the Chinese Eastern Railway: banks, committees, governments, contractors and pensions arrears; a railway financial account.

china-1923:p0703_3.rationale: Debtors of the railway, mainly Allied and Chinese governments owing for troop transport and supplies; a railway financial account.

china-1923:p0704_1.rationale: Comparison of 1921 operating profits of four Chinese railways in silver dollars.

china-1923:p0704_2.rationale: Estimated versus realised 1921 rolling stock work: train-versts, locomotive-versts, passengers, baggage and goods carried on the Chinese Eastern Railway.

china-1923:p0705_1.rationale: Poud-versts and total goods carried under general tariff on the railway, 1920 and 1921; traffic statistics.

china-1923:p0736_1.rationale: Chinese Eastern Railway estimated and realised operating revenues for 1921 by section, with increases; a railway revenue account.
